'''Infiniti''' is a Canadian Quakeworld player, mapper and developer. Originally a netquake [[CTF]] player, infiniti played in some of the top [[CTF]] clans in in north america during the late 90s and early 2000s.

After a long hiatus he returned to Quakeworld in [[2020]], hosting some CTF tournaments in NA, and soon after began getting involved in the mapping and developer communities. He has contributed various code improvements to the CTF mode in [[KTX]], and made a number of new CTF and [[Deathmatch]] maps.
